units.afterSourceText: 贾琏忙也立身说道：“好姐姐，再坐一坐，兄弟还有事相求。”说着便骂小丫头：“怎么不沏好茶来！快拿干净盖碗，把昨儿进上的新茶沏一碗来。"说着向鸳鸯道："这两日因老太太的千秋，所有的几千两银子都使了。几处房租地税通在九月才得，这会子竟接不上。明儿又要送南安府里的礼，又要预备娘娘的重阳节礼，还有几家红白大礼，至少还得三二千两银子用，一时难去支借。俗语说，`求人不如求己'。说不得，姐姐担个不是，暂且把老太太查不着的金银家伙偷着搬运出一箱子来，暂押千数两银子支腾过去。不上半月的光景，银子来了，我就赎了交还，断不能叫姐姐落不是。”鸳鸯听了，笑道：“你倒会变法儿，亏你怎么想来。”贾琏笑道：“不是我扯谎，若论除了姐姐，也还有人手里管的起千数两银子的，只是他们为人都不如你明白有胆量。

segments.text:
Jia Lian quickly rose too.
‘My good sister, sit a little longer. Your younger brother still has a favour to ask.’
Then he scolded the little maids. ‘Why haven’t you made some proper tea? Get a clean covered cup and make some of that fresh tea presented yesterday. Hurry!’
Turning to Faithful, he went on, ‘Grandmother’s birthday has used up all the several thousand taels we had. The rents from the houses and the income from the land won’t come in till the ninth month, and just now we can’t make ends meet. Tomorrow there’s a present to send to the Nan’an household; then we must prepare Her Highness’s Double Ninth gift, and there are weddings and funerals in several other families that call for substantial presents. We shall need at least another two or three thousand taels, and there’s nowhere I can readily borrow it. As they say, “Better rely on yourself than ask others.” I’m afraid I must ask you to risk the blame, sister. Quietly get out a chest of Grandmother’s gold and silver plate, things she won’t miss, and let us pawn it for a thousand taels or so to tide us over. In less than half a month, when the money comes in, I’ll redeem it and put it back. I certainly won’t let you get into trouble.’
‘You do know how to contrive things,’ Faithful said with a smile. ‘Fancy thinking of that!’
‘I’m not lying to you,’ Jia Lian said, smiling. ‘There are others besides you with a thousand taels or so under their hands. Only none of them has your good sense and courage.

units.afterSourceText: 说出来的话也不怕臊！现有对证：把太太和我的嫁妆细看看，比一比你们的，那一样是配不上你们的。”贾琏笑道：“说句顽话就急了。这有什么这样的，要使一二百两银子值什么，多的没有，这还有，先拿进来，你使了再说，如何？”凤姐道：“我又不等着衔口垫背，忙了什么。”贾琏道：“何苦来，不犯着这样肝火盛。”凤姐听了，又自笑起来，“不是我着急，你说的话戳人的心。我因为我想着后日是尤二姐的周年，我们好了一场，虽不能别的，到底给他上个坟烧张纸，也是姊妹一场。他虽没留下个男女，也不要‘前人撒土迷了后人的眼’才是。”一语倒把贾琏说没了话，低头打算了半晌，方道：“难为你想的周全，我竟忘了。

segments.text:
‘Aren’t you ashamed to say such things? There’s proof before your eyes. Take a good look at your aunt’s dowry and mine, and compare them with what your family brought. Which part of ours wasn’t good enough for you?’
‘One little joke and you fly into a temper,’ Jia Lian said with a smile. ‘What is there to make such a fuss about? If you need a hundred or two hundred taels, what’s that? I may not have more, but I can still find that much. I’ll have it brought in first. You can use it and we’ll talk afterwards. How’s that?’
‘It’s not as if I needed it this minute for my own burial. What’s the hurry?’
‘Oh, why say that? It isn’t worth working yourself into such a rage.’
Xi-feng began to smile again.
‘It isn’t that I want to lose my temper. Your words go straight to the heart. I was thinking that the day after tomorrow is the first anniversary of You Er-jie’s death. We were fond of each other, after all. Even if I can do nothing else, I ought to visit her grave and burn some paper money. We were sisters for a time. She may not have left a son or daughter, but we must not let “those who go before scatter earth in the eyes of those who follow.”’
This left Jia Lian with nothing to say. He bowed his head and thought for a good while before answering, ‘It’s kind of you to think of everything. I’d quite forgotten.
